fairExplainer: Fair odds: what each selection would pay if bookmakers took no margin (1 divided by the market probability without its margin). In green, how much the best odds pay above fair; “outlier”, a price from a single bookmaker that is most likely stale or a mistake.

status.what3: A late price never enters the picks and cannot be added to My parlay.
